title: A long bar title wraps out of the bottom of its bar
goal: Type a long title into the starter Nav Bar and the words wrap onto a second line that hangs below the bar, through its bottom hairline. A bar title should stay on one line and give way some other way when it does not fit.
notes: Seen on 2026-09-06 while landing a-control-added-to-a-bar-does-not-vanish-behind. The title is now an in-flow Fill item, so GroupFlow.wrapRooms treats it like any other row label and wraps it to the room left over (Title box goes 248x36 in a 48-tall bar). Before that change it was Stretch and overhung sideways instead. Probably wants a per-layer no-wrap answer, or a rule that a row whose height is a typed number never wraps a label past that height. See docs/design/ui-building.md, "A field and a bar keep their width on purpose".
acceptance: A title too long for the room left in the bar stays on one line
Nothing the bar draws hangs below the bar itself
